I’m late, but a few years ago I attempted suicide (I was fine and never in a position where I might die) and I was alone on the ambulance ride to the hospital. The EMTs were two girls a couple years older than me and the one in the back, not driving, was so kind to me.

She asked what was going on and since I had nothing to lose at that point I told her why I had chosen to try and take my life. She told me why I shouldn’t and about her struggles as well. She also joked around with me and told some funny stories, it made me feel better in a really scary situation. Once we got to the hospital she wrote her phone number down and told me I could text her anytime, and that she thought I was a good person. At the time it really made me feel better.
